text:
DEPARTMENT OF INFORMATION SCIENCE
GLOBAL INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & ENGINEERING
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Sneha Patel, who I have mentored as Personal Family Friend and Distant Relative during their study period (2020-2024) at Global Institute of Science & Engineering.

During this tenure, Sneha Patel demonstrated exceptional mastery in C++, CUDA, Embedded Robotics, ROS2. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'Distributed Consensus in Fault-Tolerant Blockchain Networks', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Additionally, the candidate maintained an exemplary academic record with a GPA of 9.4 / 10.0.

Beyond technical competence, Sneha Patel displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Sneha Patel among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Dr. Meenakshi Sundaram
Associate Professor
Information Science
Global Institute of Science & Engineering
Email: .meenakshi.sundaram@globalinst.edu
